tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rgyal sku lnga dang tse dmar ya ba skya bdun gyi rten mdos lag len gsal byed mkhas grub brgyud pa'i srol 'dzin bzhugs so// swa sti/ chos rgyal sku lnga dang / tse dmar ya ba skya bdun gyi rten mdos kyi bsham la/ shing gi a dar mdos che chung dang bstun nas bzo ba las 'dir ri rab bang rim 'og ma'i zhing la khru do yod pa'i dbang du btang nas/ de'i mthar gling bzhi la sor brgyad kyi zheng dang / gling phran la sor bzhi'i zheng / gling bzhi gling phran dang ri rab kyi bar la gser gyi ri bdun rol mtsho bdun bcas pa'i zheng la sor bzhi/ gling bzhi gling phran de dag gi phyi nas lcags ris bskor ba dang bcas/ mdos gdan gyi shing gi zheng la khru do mtho gang gru bzhi 'jam pa gtsang ma la rin chen brdar ba phon che bar brdar te/ phyi'i lcags ri ni brag ri sngon po zlum por bskor ba/ de'i nang ris kyi bar la rgya mtsho'i mdog shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ser/ lcags ri nas nang du sor gang tsam bral ba'i sar shar du zla gam dkar po bcad kha nub la bstan pa gsum/ lhor sog kha sngon po 'phel kha byang bstan/ nub tu zlum dmar gsum/ byang du gru bzhi ser po gsum rnams kyi dbus ma rnams la zheng sor brgyad/ g.yas g.yon rnams la zheng sor bzhi yod par/ ri klung shing chu thams cad kyi mi dang dud 'gro sogs kyis gzugs thor tsam yod pa/ gling bzhi gling phran de dag gi nang ri rab kyi mthar ri ser po bdun gyis bskor ba'i srubs rnams su/ rol mtsho mtshon byed chu ris sngon po/ ri rab 'og ma'i dpangs la sor brgyad zheng la khru do/ /de'i steng dpangs sor drug zheng gnyis pa las sor do'i chung bar/ de'i steng dpangs sor drug zheng gnyis pa las sor do'i chu bar/ de steng dpangs sor lnga zheng gsum pa las sor do'i chung bar/ bang rim gnyis pa dang / gsum pa'i mtshams nas/ gong gi rgya mtsho'i shes/

bang rim steng ma'i steng lcags ri spe'u khang bzang dang bcas pa'i dkyil du mdos kyi srog shing btsugs/ khang bzang gi nang srog shing rgyab zhal shar bstan pa srog 'khor gyi ga'u rgyab mdun ma nor bar btags/ mkhar gyi nang du rin po che dang dar zab gang shong / zur gyi spe'u bzhi la rgyal mtshan/ mkhar gyi sgo drug du sku lnga'i mdos la bsangs phye lnga/ mkhar gyi mthar bskor du gtor ma gru bzhi/ mkhar thabs gru gsum/ bdud bshos mgo gug zlum po rnams las/ gzhan rnams la smug rtsi dang / bdud bshos nag po/ zlum gtor dkar po/ tse dmar la gtor ma gru gsum dmar po dbus su gcig de'i g.yon du re re/ mdun du gsum/ rgyab tu gcig sku lnga dang rtse dmar gnyis ka'i gtor ma rnams kyi g.yas g.yon du rdza thod chung ngu / dpral ba rang la bstan pa gnyis bzhag pa'i g.yas ma nas glum gyis phyur bur bkang ba'i dkyil du bdud rtsi ril bu/ g.yon ma khrag skam rlon gang rung gi bkang bas/ khar sman raka gtor ma dang bcas pa'i phyi'i lcags ri'i nang du mtshams 'dzin chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ de'i nang du drag mchod la zhabs bsil dang mtshams 'dzin kha bkang bar de'i mthar dpag bsam shing sogs mdos gzhung nas byung ba'i tsakli dang / bkra shis rdzas rtags/ sna bdun/ sna lnga/ go khrab/ dbu chings/ khrab/ gdan/ l+h+wam/ mtshon bya dang / lpags rigs rnams kyis cha snyoms par bskor/ tsakli dang lpags rigs go khrab sogs tshang mar shing rkang re la brten pa'i gyed langs legs 'dra bzhin/ shong na de ltar dang / so so chung ngu'i rigs rnams kyis 'di bskor rgyu yin yang / ma shong na phyi'i lcags ri'i nang gling bzhi gling phran gser ri rol mtsho dang bcas hrag rnams su/ sha lnga khrag sna gang 'byor yang de dag gi gras yin zhing / mkhar gyi lcags ri la 'phur dgu/ 'dzul dgu/ 'grim dgu/ rta a tsa ra bud med/ ru 'dren/ skyo bsang pa rnams kyi tsakli la gral rim med pas cha snyoms gang mdzes su btsugs/

phyi'i lcags ri la shar du nam mkha' shel mig bzhi/ rgyang bu bzhi/ pho gdong / mo gdong / mda' khra/ 'phang khra rnams grangs ci rigs/ lhor g.yu mig bzhi rgyang bu sogs/ nub du mtshal mig bzhi rgyang bu sogs/ byang du gser mig bzhi rgyang bu sogs/ dbus kyi mkhar rgya phigs dang bcas pa'i srog shing la brten pa'i gdugs nyis brtsegs la sku lnga/ gzhi stong skud dkar po/ mtha' rnam bzhi'i 'ja' can/ tse dmar la gzhi sngon po/ mtha' rnam bzhi'i 'ja' can/ rtsibs bcu gnyis po dag gi sne phran phra btags pa/ de'i steng khyung tshang gru bzhi'i steng gi zur rnams la rgyal mtshan re/ de'i khyung tshang gru ching gi zur rnams la thod skam dang / rnga ril rnga phod dang / dar mtshon rnam lnga brkyang ba/ rtse gsum yungs dkar gang bu/ bya rgod kyi sgro phod rnams btsugs pa ste/ brten mdos kyi bshom mdos gzhi tshang ma dang / zhal la rang re'i phyag len dang bstun pa'i rgyab phyogs kyi dgos char phur lnga/ sman raka dam rdzas bcu tshar dang / bkram bskang / thun gtor/ phud chang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod/ tshogs 'khor/ rdo dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ 'thor nas/ phur pa lnga/ yungs dkar/ gu gul dkar nag nub dang po la dgos pa'i bum pa/ dung chos rdor bzung / sbyangs khrus kyi chas/ rnga rol dung rkang gling / gu gul bsangs dud/ nub tha mar dgos pa'i bsgral mchod kyis chas/ phur pa gsum/ ral gri/ tho ba/ bstan skyong kyi gtor ma ste/ sbyor ba'i yo byad tshang ma dang / dngos gzhi'i nyin bdun bgyis na/ nyin drug gi bar la bdag bskyed phur chen la byin 'bebs rgyas pa'i bsdus pa dang / 'bring po rgyas bsdus gnyis res mos/ dbyangs rnams nyin gsum rer bkral ba/ nyin dang po bstan 'dus la sbyangs khrus mdzad pa'ang bla ma gong ma kha shas kyi phyag len la snang bas/ de'i tshul la 'dir bdag bskyed phur pa byas pa'i dbang du btang ste/ sgrub thabs rgyas pa ltar na rig 'dzin bskul gyi rjes dang /

'bring bsdus ltar na bzlas pa bsdus nas bum pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yer ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyis shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las/ 'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus zhal ljang / /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pas rgya gram be con bsnams/ /tha mas phur bsgril yum la 'khyud/ /rdo rje'i khyung gshog rab tu gdengs/ /lha mo rdo rje sgra mdzad ljang / /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis gnyis med rol/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum gnyis/ /brgyan song yab yum tshul bzhin ste/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros ye shes pa yab yum oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya wak+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swā bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ thabs kyis spyod pas nas shwa ri a bar/ yab yum gnyis la khro bo rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ sgeg phreng sogs/ rang byung sh+lau ka gcig sngags bcas/ 'khor ba'i nyon mongs dug dang 'dra ba las/ /ye shes bdud rtsi sman gyis rtsi gtor zhing / /thugs rjes kun la khyab pas dbyings su 'khyil/ /khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang gi sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la zhon nas song bas bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ sku lus las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li sogs 'phreng 'khor mchod bstod gong bzhin yig brgya gsum/

ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lau ka gcig oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ sogs kyis dung chos kyis chu phul/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yab yum 'od du zhu ba ye shes kyis bdud rtsir gyur/ gtor bsngos rgyun bzhin bshags pa gsum/ bskang ba thugs dam ma mgon dbyangs kyis gzhung bsrang / rig 'dzin myur 'byon gyi 'phrin bcol gyi bar gzhung bzhin byas la/ de'i tshig rol gyi rjes su gsum brdeg len can byas la rnga rol bzhag nyin dang por mdos drung du sbyangs chas bsgrigs la chus sbyangs/ sgrub po lang shing zhwa gyon/ zhi ba dang / zhi drag phyed ma dang / drag pos sbyangs rnams rgyun bzhin byas la/ bden brdar gyi tshe/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang zhes pa nas/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / /'jam dpal sku zhes pa nas/ bden pa yang dag pa dang bden pa chen pos byin brlabs kyis/ bstan bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i rten mdos 'jug pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs sogs/ rten byin rlabs can rten khrus/ mdos la/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i sogs rgyun bzhin/ gang la ser sna sogs/ yang ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ sku phyi bar rgyun bzhin/ mdos la khrus gsol byas pa de bum par mi blug cing / thog mar sku lnga'i rten mdos la sngags drug phyag drug gi byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ thal mo khong stong dang / oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ mdos glud rnams kyi 'bags pa dang / mi gtsang ba sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ dpral bar thal mo khong stong gi mdzub mo dbus ma rnams kyis tshig bar pa bcag pa dang / oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ mdos rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por brgyun mi 'chad par gyur cig /rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya dang /

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos glud rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur pa thams cad mgron so so'i yid bzhin du thob pa la gegs dang nyer 'tshe med par gyur cig mchog sbyin mnyam bzhag dang / oṃ a ka ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a d+yaṃ nut+pan na tod oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mdos mgron so so'i gang la gang 'dod pa'i dngos po yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig g.yon pa khu tshur dang / g.yas khu tshur gyis mdzub mo bsgreng bzhin skor ba dang / oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs man+ta s+pha ra ṇa ras smin bhā wa ma hā ma ni du ru du ru hrī da ya dz+wa la swāhā/ mdos mgron rnams drag zhan che chung med par so so'i yid du tshim zhing rang dbang du longs spyod par gyur cig rdo rje bsdam pa nang bcing srang mthe bong gnyis kyis mnan pa spyi bor skor nas/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha naṃ gra hi shwa ri pra pañtsa ti/ ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdos rdzas rnams bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du zad pa med cing mgron so so rnams mnyes pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig de thams cad kyi sngags rnams tshar gsum re dang sngags re re la phyag rgya re re bcas pa'i mthar se gol brdab pa'o/ /ri rab steng khang bzang nang gi srog 'khor/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang rgyu bkod pa ngo mtshar du mas khyad par du byas pa'i nang du ma traṃ bsnol ba'i gzhi'i dbus su thugs kyi rgyal po mthing nag dar nag gi ber dang dom gyi slog pa can dbu la dar nag gi thebs gzhu gsol ba bdud zhags dang spu gri thogs pa/ ba glang sna ring chibs nas rol du glog dmar khrid pa/ shar du sku'i rgyal po mon bu pu tra mthing nag man gri nag po'i gos can dbu la dar nag gi thibs zhu gsol ba rdo rje dang sher shing /

gseg shang sna tshogs pa/ seng ge la chibs nas rol du dom nag khrid pa/ lhor yon tan gyi rgyal po shing bya can mthing nag sbrul dang / stag gi gos can/ dbu la thebs khyung mgo can gsol ba/ dgra satwa dang / bdud zhags thogs pa/ bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs nas rol du g.yu 'brug khrid pa/ nub du gsung gi rgyal po dgra bla skyes cig dmar po dar nag ber can dbu la smyug zhu gsol ba/ sba 'gying khar dang / tsan+dan gyi beng chen thogs pa/ dril nag rkang dkar la chibs nas rol du spyang mo khrid pa/ byang du phrin las kyi rgyal po pe har dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug pa dar dkar gyi ral ga dang / stag lpags kyis sham thabs can/ dbu la tshag zhu gsol ba/ g.yas gsum lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon gsum spu gri gzhu dang ber ka thogs pa/ seng ge dkar po la chibs nas rol du tshub ma khrid pa/ lnga ka'ang phrin las bzhi'i rnam rol ci yang 'char zhing / rgyan dang cha lugs phun sum tshogs pa gzi brjid tshad med pa/ so so'i sprul pa dang / yum dang blon po pho nya ru 'dren gar mkhan skyo bsangs bag ma sogs pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas gung sngon mthon po'i yang steng bha ṭa hor gyi sgom grwa zab yangs chos 'khor chen po sogs gar bzhugs gyi gnas nas rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom dung bcom rol bsangs bzhin la/ chems rdung la rkang gling / gu gul bsang dud sogs sbyar/ spyan 'dren tshig rkang drug hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin ma'i dbyangs dang / tshig rkang lnga la rol mo gdangs ring thung bcas/ hūm̐ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas mchog nas/ /ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ba'i chos skyong ni/ /gnod sbyin rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas/ /dam tshig gzhung bzhin srung ba'i skyes mchog rnams/

/thugs dam brgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dbyangs rdzogs pa'i gsum brdeg len can mthar chems brdung rkang gling / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a la la ho/ e h+ya hi bha ga wan aṃ ku sha sa mā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gsum brdeg len can yang dag don du dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ rin chen sna lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas 'dir/ /nyi zla pad+ma gdan khri mdzes pa la/ /sprul pa'i rgyal chen sku lnga 'khor dang bcas/ /bstan pa bsrung phyir gnyis med brtan par bzhugs/ /gsum brdeg len can chems rdung / sa mā ya a we sha ya satwaṃ/ gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥ lan gsum mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ badz+ra tri du rak+ṣa yak+ṣa hūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha hi/ rang gi myangs/ sngags de nyid kyis chos skyong la gtor/ mchod 'bul tshig rkang drug la gang thugs ma'i bu dbyangs dang drug pa jar bcas/ hūm̐ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /bstan pa bsrung phyir 'bar ba'i sku sprul pa/ /rgyud drug sgrol mdzad rig 'dzin sgrub mchog la/ /rgyal chen yid 'phrog mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod/ /chos 'khor bka' dang bstan pa'i snying po bsrung / /dgra bgegs tshar chod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod/ /gsum brdeg len can byas la rnga rol bzhag rā dza sid+dhi sa mā ya ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du me tog nas rol mo'i bar la'ang mtshan sngags sbyar ba dang phyag rgyas mchod/ mtheb srin gyis sman raka thor ba'i stangs ka dang / ma hā a mṛ ta pu dza kha hi/ ma hā rak+ta pu dza kha hi/ rdor thal kha gyen bstan se gol gtogs pa dang bcas/ rā dza sid+dhi sa mā ya ba liṃ ta kha khā hi/ lan bdun mdos sogs mchod pa'i yo byad phul bar bsam la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ lan gsum sku lnga'i gsol mchod sh+lau ka gcig la myur mgyogs sde brgyad kyis dbyangs rol dang bcas/

hūm̐ dgra bgegs log 'dren tshar gcod gnas mchog 'dir/ /rin chen sku lnga'i ri rab gzhal yas khang / /nyi zla pad+ma ru tra'i gdan gyi steng / /sprul pa'i chos rgyal sku lnga dbyings nas bzhengs/ /sku mdog smug nag dom gyi slog pa gsol/ /g.yas g.yon phyag na bdud zhags spu gri bsnams/ dar nag zhu gsol ba glang sna ring chibs/ /thugs kyi rgyal chen gsol lo phrin las mdzod/ /mon bu mthing nag man tri nag po gsol/ /g.yas g.yon phyag na rdo rje gseg shang bsnams/ /thebs gzhu gsol zhing dom nag smyon pa khrid/ /sku yi rgyal chen gsol lo phrin las mdzod/ /gnod sbyin nag po stag sbrul g.yang bzhis brgyan/ /g.yas g.yon satwa gri bdud zhags dgra la 'phen/ /khyung mgos dbang bdud srid pa'i g.yu 'brug khrid/ /yon tan rgyal chen gsol lo phrin las mdzod/ /dgra lha skyes cig dar nag 'jo ber gsol/ /g.yas g.yon sba mkhar tsan+dan beng chen bsnams/ /spyang mo khrid cing pho nya bya khra 'gyed/ /gsung gi rgyal chen gsol lo phrin las mdzod/ /pe har zhal gsum phyag drug tshag zhu gsol/ /lcags kyu mda' dar spu gri gzhu dbyug tho/ /dar dkar gsol zhing stag chas seng ge chibs/ /phrin las rgyal chen gsol lo phrin las mdzod/ /rgyal chen sku lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas/ /sman raka sha khrag gtor mas thugs dam bskangs/ /nyams bshags yul 'khor longs spyod bstan pa spel/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig la gang thugs ma'i dbyangs ring rol mo bcas/ hūm̐ sgrub mchog bdud 'dul ye shes thugs dam bskangs/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad thugs rje nyi ma 'dra/ /dam nyams gdug pa'i dgra bgegs kun grol ba'i/ /thugs rje snyoms mdzad khyod la bdag bstod do/ /'gyur med dbyings las 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs pa/ /skye med chos kyi don rtogs sgrub mchog khyod/

/skye 'chi brtsad gcod legs nyes btang 'dzin pa'i/ /thog med 'jigs byed khyod la bdag bstod do/ /sku gsung thugs ni chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam/ /phrin las mthar phyin khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul/ /drag tu bskul na dgra bgegs dbang du bsdus/ /rgyal po sde lnga 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ /rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ mdos gzhung sh+lau ka gcig la dpal ldan dbang ldan ma'i dbyangs rol/ lan gnyis bcas/ hūm̐ gdod nas dag pa ka dag chos kyi sku/ /lhun grub zhi khro'i zlos gar longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i rnam rol pad+ma 'byung / /sku gsum dbyer med dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /bskal pa dang po bdud dang klu yi sras/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug dge bsnyen chen po grags/ /bar gyi bskal par bha ṭa hor yul du/ /sgom grwa'i dkor bsrung rgyal po pe ha ra/ /tha ma'i dus su bod yul gangs can 'dir/ /chos 'khor ma lus skyong ba'i bsrung ma che/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcas la/ /dgyes par skyed par byed pa'i mchod pa ni/ /rin chen shel dkar baiḍūr+ya sngon po/ /pad+ma rā ga gser las grub pa yi/ /ri rab lhun po bang rim bzhi pa'i steng / /pho brang sku mkhar rgya phub lcog gi mdzes/ /khor yug sra brtan lcags ris yongs su bskor/ /nang du lha dang mi yi 'dod yon ni/ /phun tshogs ngo mtshar rgya mtshos yongs gang ba/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol ba'i don rnams kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /steng na 'ja' tshon ltar bkra gdugs dang srog /sgro phod yungs dkar gang bzang dag gis mtshan/ /dar gyi 'phan dang cod paṇa lhab lhub g.yo/ /nam mkha' rgyang bu spel mar tshar du mngar/ /chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang rol mo'i tshogs/ /'dod yon rnam lnga sra brtan rdo rje'i go

/rno ba'i mtshon cha zhwa phod sag thebs dang / /rin chen rus brgyan lpags pa'i rgyal mtshan tshogs/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i don rnams kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rta lug bya khyi byi la ra dkar dang / /spre'u seng gi stag gzig dom dred gung / /'dab bya sna tshogs glang chen rta g.yag drel/ /phun tshogs 'dod yon khur ba'i khal ma dang / /smyug rgod rtse brgya bya dkar gseb kyi nang / /da ha ga'u gsang ba'i srog 'khor dang / /stag gzig ras ma snam ras dkar dmar sngo/ /kha dog lnga ldan rnga ma'i chun po rnams/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor dang༞ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i༞ /sngags 'chang bdag gis༞ /'bad med lhun gyi grub༞ phun tshogs ro brgya'i dpal ldan gtor ma dang / /sde brgyad bshos bu 'bru dar sman sna lnga/ /pho gdong mo gdong shing gri yul mkhar ris/ /phung khams bskyed byed tshangs pa'i ngar glud mdzes/ /bdud rtsi gser skyems 'phyi ba'i sha tshil gsur/ /sha chen spos dkar dud pa mda' dar lnga/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas rten du 'bul/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde bla ma'i sku tshe spel/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i don rnams kun/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /chos skyong rgyal po sde lnga 'khor bcas rnams/ /bstan las ma g.yo dam las ma 'da' bar/ /sangs rgyas bstan dang dge 'dun sde rnams skyongs/ /rdo rje slob dpon sku tshe phrin las spel/ /gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir mi phyugs nad/ /'thab rtsod mu ge nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la spyod par mdzod/ /khyad par rig 'dzin bdag gi nad gdon bgegs/

/zhi zhing tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor rgyas/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus gnag pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /myur du snying khrag drod mo zhal du gsol/ /mdor na rgyal dbang pad+ma nyang ral zhabs/ /rgod ldem legs ldan rje dang dbang po'i sde/ /khyab bdag bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i dge legs mdzod/ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ yang dbyangs rol med par 'dur ma tshar gnyis te kun bsgril lan gsum gyi gsum pa'i mjug tu/ gsum pa'i tshig rol mthar chems rdung rkang dung gsum brdeg len can rnams kyis rgyal chen sku'i mdos kyi rim pa'o// ༈ /yang tse dmar gyi mdos yod na gong bzhin sngags drug phyag drug gis byin rlabs dang srog 'khor bsang sbyangs rnams gong bzhin la/ stong pa'i ngang las brtan mdos ri rab kyi steng gzhal yas khang gi nang btsan yul zangs mkhar dmar po zangs brag gnam la bsnyegs pa rtse la rgod smug lding ba/ logs la btsan skya rgyu ba/ sked na gcan gzan ngu ba/ rtsa bar dug chu khol ba/ brag ri dmar po'i nang du khrag mtsho 'khor zhing bse mkhar smug po zangs kyi sgo lcags can btsan mkhar 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus na tri bdun yongs su gyur pa las lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po tse dmar ba sku mdog dmar ljang ral pa dmar po me 'od 'khrigs pa/ spyan nas me'i skar mda' 'khrug pa/ zhal nas khrag gi ser chen 'bebs pa/ mche ba rnon po gangs ri ltar brtsegs pa/ ljags glog ltar 'khyugs pa/ khro zhing 'jigs la rngam zhing btum pa/ sku la dar dmar gyi ber chen za 'og sngo khra'i go lag can gsol ba/ rin chen gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ dbu la dar dmar gyi 'gying thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ bse phub dmar po rgyab du 'khyil ba/ phyag g.yas btsan gyi zhags pa dmar pos dgra bo 'chings zhing / g.yon bse mdung dmar po dar dmar gyi ru mtshon can snying la bsnun pa/

rta bra bo sgab nag dar gdan dmar po/ sga khra bo/ dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob chen/ gser gyi srab/ ga mu'i mthur mda'/ dar dmar gyi srab skyogs/ sbrul nag gi gong smad byas pa la chibs nas/ stong gsum bskor ba/ sku la zhal gyi lha can sku mdog dkar por kha gtum can/ sku la za 'og dmar khra'i gos dang / dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ g.yas su stag dong dang / g.yon gzig shub 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis gser mda' gser gzhur bkar ste/ dgra bo'i snying la brdeg pa/ smug po sha sdong sga srab can la chibs pa/ gro shod bod kyi sgang dmag sku mdog dmar po me 'od 'bar ba rngam zhing 'jigs pa sku la le brgan gyi 'jo ber dang / dar gyi thod bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang / gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon zangs zhags dmar pos dgra bo bcings te/ g.yas kyi shang lang brdeg pa/ chibs su rting dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ ra tsa gos sngon gyi klu btsan sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba/ sku la chu dar sngon po'i ral ga la dug sbrul gyis ske rags bcings pa/ dar sngon gyi thod can/ stag dong g.yas dang / gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas lcags mdung nag po dang / g.yon dug sbrul gyi zhags pa 'phen pa/ rta ser po sga srab can la chibs pa/ rdo ring dmar pos grib btsan sku mdog dmar po 'jigs pa'i gzugs can ber dmar gyi slog pa dang / dar dmar gyi thod gsol ba/ stag dong g.yas dang / gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po dang / g.yon btsan gyi rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ rkyang dmar sbo dkar sga srab can la chibs pa/ kaṃ ka thod nag bdud btsan sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa/ sku la dar nag ber can dang / bdud zhags nag po thod du bcings pa/ stag dong g.yas dang gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas dar nag gi ru mtshon 'phyar zhing / g.yon pas breng zhags bla la 'debs pa/ rag pa gzhung nag sga srab can la chibs pa/

rtsal thog rgyug gi grib btsan sku mdog khrag ltar dmar ba/ sku la zangs khrab dmar po dang / dbu la dar dmar thod chings/ stag dong g.yas dang / gzig shub g.yon du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas bse mdung dmar po me 'od 'phro ba gsol zhing / g.yon zangs kyi ral gri glog ltar 'khyug pa/ rta mchog rlung gi gshog pa sga srab can la chibs pa/ bdun ka'ang ri khyi spyang ki rol du 'khrig pa/ ri bya pho rog steng du lding ba/ btsan dmag 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs pa/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas btsan rgod ya ba skya bdun 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom dung bcom rol rkang gling bcas rnam sras bskang gso bzhin/ spyan 'dren phyogs phyogs ma sh+lau ka gcig la/ shwa ring gi dbyangs rol rkang gling bcas/ kyai phyogs phyogs 'di ni pha ki na/ /nyi ma nub phyogs pha ki na/ /btsan yul zangs thang dmar po na/ /pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa/ /che btsan rol pa skya bdun ni/ /phal cher sku mdog dmar po la/ /phyag na ba dan zhags pa bsnams/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /tshur byon tshur byon gnas 'dir byon/ /tshig rol chems brdung rkang gling / /shu la tri badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ bh+yoḥbatsan mkhar dmar po'i nang shed na/ /sha khrag longs spyod bsam mi khyab/ /yid 'ong spyan gzigs kun nas mdzes/ /dam tshig gtsang ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /tshig rol chems rdung / shu la tri sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ kyai skyes bu rol pa skya bdun ni/ /phrin las mdzad pa bsam mi khyab/ /pad+ma dbang gi bka' nyan pa/ /dam tshig gter bdag khyod la bstod/ /gtsang ma'i sku khrus 'di 'bul lo/ /bdag dang yon gyi bdag po la/ /thugs rje dbang gi nyer bar mdzod/ /tshig rol chems rdung / ar+ghaṃ bi shud+dho swāhā/ gtsang ma'i bdug spos sprin ltar gtibs/ /me tog snang gsal dri chab dang / /zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul/ /thugs dam dbang gi nye bar mdzod/

/dhuṣ+pe/ puṣ+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+ta pu tsa ho/ tshig rol chems brdung 'bebs bcas/ gtor ma/ a ka lan bdun gyis bsngos/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod/ bskang gso sh+lau ka gcig la nag po gnod sbyin dbyangs rol bcas/ kyai skyes bu srog gi bdag po ni/ /'jigs byed rol pa skya bdun tshogs/ /khyed la dgyes pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /sha khrag dmar gtor ri ltar spungs/ /zag med bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil/ /rak+ta'i yon chab rdzing bu gtams/ /spyan gzigs longs spyod skar ltar bkram/ rnga gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog /glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshogs dang bcas/ /dam can sde bdun thugs dam bskang / /btsan rgod 'bar ba'i thugs dam bskang / /dkor bsrung dam can thugs dam bskang / /las bzhi pho nya'i thugs dam bskang / /bh+yoḥbatsan mkhar dmar po ldem se ldem/ /dar dmar ru mtshon pu ru ru/ /ba dan dmar po yang se yang / /dregs pa'i mda' 'phen bring nge bring / /las byed shan pa rol lo lo/ /bshug pa'i gso sgra di ri ri/ /che btsan rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang / /slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ /thugs dam zhal bzhes de dgongs la/ /khri srong lde'u btsan rje rigs dang / /sngags 'chang dam ldan brgyud par bcas/ /dam tshig gcig tu skyong ba la/ /sku la bsdo ba'i rigs rgyud chod/ /log lta'i bdud dpung cham la phob/ /sngags 'chang rdo rje'i dam ma 'da'/ /bcol lo gnyer ro mthu stsal can/ /yal yol bri gang ma mdzad cig /ngo bsrung zas phyir ma 'brang mdzod/ /thugs dang 'gal bar de bskang la/ /bu dang tsha bo bzhin du skyongs/ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig la gang thugs ma'i dbyangs rol mo bcas/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /las smon mthu las grub pa'i dam tshig can/ /chos skyong gnod sbyin chen po zhes grags pa'i/ /bka' sdod stobs ldan khyod la bdag bstod do/

/rab 'jigs bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i sku/ /khro gnyer bzhin bsdus aṃ gtsigs gdang mig bsgrad/ /mdung dmar zhags pas ru tra 'chings bzhin sgrol/ /dam nyams gshed ma khyod la bdag bstod do/ /rig 'dzin pad+ma'i rje 'bangs spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar zhal bzhes dam las mi g.yel zhing / /dpal gyi bsam yas mi 'gyur bar khang du/ /smon lam gcig bsdus lha srin 'dus pa'i tshogs/ /bka' yi dam tshig gnyen po ji bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag dang brgyud par bcas pa yi/ /dam tshig sgrub la tshul bzhin skyong ba dang / /bstan gyi dgra lha chos skyong khyed gsol na/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung bstan dang bstan 'dzin spel/ /bar chad bgegs thul sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol/ /chos 'khor gnyen skyong mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ rang bzhin rnam dag sh+lau ka gcig la sgeg cing ma'i dbyangs bcas/ bh+yoḥrang bzhin rnam dag 'phrul gyi gzhal yas nas/ /gnod sbyin dmar po gtum chen mthu bo che/ /sku mdog dmar po khrag mdog ya la la/ /khrag mdog mche ba dmar po btsegs se btsegs/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa kun gyi stong dpon mdzod/ /drag shugs stobs ldan mthu ldan stong dpon che/ /g.yas pas ba dan dgra bo'i snying la gzer/ /g.yon pas zhags pas dgra bo'i ske nas 'chings/ /dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la rngam par mdzod/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la/ /byur dang ltas ngan thams cad dgra la bsgyur/ /rnal 'byor chags che nyam nga zlog tu gsol/ /rtag tu 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrub/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rdzogs mtshams tshig rol/ sangs rgyas bstan srung sh+lau ka gsum la/ 'jam rdor ma'i dbyangs mjug myur ba rol mo bcas/ sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod/ /dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel/

/snyan pa'i dar 'phyor grags pa'i dung bus la/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod/ /rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas/ /mig la ya mtshan ltas mo che ba dang / /rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing / /dri zhim dwangs pa sna dang mi 'bral mdzod/ /zas skom 'byor pas ro mchog tshim byed cing / /lus la reg 'jam bde ba kho nas 'tsho/ /yid kyang rnam par bkra ba'i shes rab kyi/ /zag med bde bas nam yang rol par mdzod/ /rtag tu khyod mchod khyod gsol khyod sgrub na/ /mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod/ /gzhi la bkra shis longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /byes su lam 'phrang chu la sgrol 'don mdzod/ /'jigs pa'i dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba skyobs/ /mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis/ /bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / /mthun rkyen ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /rgyal chen khyod la phrin las bcol ba ni/ /'dren mchog shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /gangs can ljongs 'dir bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams/ /zhabs srid brtan zhing yun ring grogs mdzod cig /yul 'khor mtha' dag 'tshe ba med pa dang / /chos dang mthun pa'i gsol ba btab pa la/ /don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /gang zhig yid la dran pa tsam kyi kyang / /'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar mdzad pa yi/ /chos skyong yid bzhin nor bu khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam don ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /mthu ldan kun khyab ma rgyun bzhin/ mdos gzhung sh+lau ka gcig la mgon bstod sngon tshe ma'i dbyangs rol bcas/ sngon tshe sangs rgyas 'od srungs bstan pa'i mjug /byang phyogs li yul lcang ra smug po nas/ /pha ni rje btsun ma ni ut+pal brgyan/ /sras su 'khrung pa'i 'phyor pa zhes bya bas/

/dge slong tsan+dan bha har sdom pa blangs/ /nags tshal khrod gnas mchod sbyin byed pa'i tshe/ /lha lcam de phyin dug sbrul 'jigs pa las/ /skyabs tshe blun pos mthong nas ya ga bsgrags/ /rgyal po khros nas gsod du chas pa na/ /lha lcam ldebs sogs rgyu mtshan thos pa yis/ /sras de kha ba can gyi ljongs su bros/ /nam zhig dmag gi li sras gri ru krongs/ /gdug sems smon lam btab pa'i 'bras bu las/ /btsan rje zla ba thod dkar rigs brgyud du/ /khrag gi sgo nga skyes pa rdol ba'i nang / /btsan rgod gnod sbyin chen po tse dmar ba/ /zhe sdang mthu yis mgo las bdud btsan nag /rus las lha btsan drod las khrag gi btsan/ /khrag las grib btsan chu ser klu yi btsan/ /sha yi btsan las grib btsan dug byung bas/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun zhes grags pas/ /srid gsum tshe srog za zhing phung byed tshe/ /dpal chen rta mgrin dbang gi dam btags pas/ /lha btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po spun bdun po/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng gi /chos 'khor gnyen po'i bsrung mar bka' bsgos pa/ /'dir spyon 'dir spyon brten pa'i mdos la bzhugs/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ lha khyod dgyes pa skyed pa'i mchod rdzas ni/ /shel dang baiḍūr+ya pad rāg gser sbyar las/ /grub pa'i lhun po bang rim bzhi ldan steng / /pho brang sku mkhar rgya phub lcog gi mdzes/ /gling bzhi gling phran mtha' nas lcags ris bskor/ /nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten mun pa sel/ /dpag bsam shing dang 'dod pa 'jo ba'i ba/ /ma rmos lo tog rin chen ri bo mtho/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun gyis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brtan bzhugs nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol ba'i las kun sgrub/ /gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro brgya'i zas/

/'jam mnyen gos dang khrag chang mchod yon bsgreng / /dbang po'i me tog gsur chen dud sprin 'khrigs/ /zhun chen mar me mkhris pa'i dri chab 'khyil/ /sha rus zhal zas rol mo sna tshogs ldir/ /rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la a mṛ ta/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ldan gtor ma'i tshogs/ /dmar chen rak+ta'i rba rlabs mkha' la 'phyo/ /'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi mchod sprin 'dis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun༞ /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu༞ /sngags 'chang bdag gi bcol༞ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ kyai ye zhes sbyar la/ steng na 'ja' ltar bkra zhes sogs sh+lau ka gcig bdag nyid ma'i dbyangs rol bcas/ steng na 'ja' ltar bkra ba dar zab gdugs/ /sgro phod gang bzang phyag mtshan tog gis mdzes/ /sna tshogs dar gyi 'phan dang cod paṇa g.yo/ /'jam mnyen 'dab chags sgro spus thod bcings pa'i/ /nam mkha' ljang bu dbang po'i gzhu ris can/ /mda' khra 'phang khra grangs tshang bsnol mar bkod/ /lcags zangs bse yi khrab rmog sba bse'i phub/ /sna tshogs rnga ma'i rgyan ldan zhol btags sogs/ /rang bsrung rdo rje go cha'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la༞ /sngags 'chang༞ /dmar nag lcags mdung bse mdung dar lce can/ /zangs lcags ral gri dgra satwa mda' dang mdung / /'ching byed sgyu ma 'breng pa dug sbrul dang / /zhags pa dmar po lcags kyi a long can/ /dar dmar za 'og dmar khra le brgan las/ /grub pa'i 'jol ber rtse ber dmar nag dang / /ral gu sngon po sngo dmar dar gyi thod/ /sag l+h+wam dmar po gser gyi ska rags la/ /rin chen sna tshogs phra yis rab spras pas/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rten mdos 'di la rtag tu brtan bzhugs nas/ /sngags 'chang bdag gis bcol ba'i las kun bsgrubs/ /cang shes rta mchog bra bo sgab nag dang / /sha gdong smug po mtsha' lu rting dkar can/

/gser gyi mdog ldan rkyang dmar sbo dkar dang / /rag pa gzhung nag rlung gi shugs can la/ /dar gdan steng du rta sga khra bos mdzes/ /dngul gyi yob thag zangs kyi yob chen dang / /gser srab g.yu gzab dar dmar srab skyogs can/ /dug sbrul nag pos gong smad rgyan spras nas/ /stong gsum skad cig nyul ba'i bzhon pa 'dis/ /gnod spyin mched bdun༞ /sogs/ /glang chen stag gzig lpags pa zhing chen gos/ /mi mgo skam rlon do zhags rin chen brgyan/ /g.yag rgod ra lug khyi 'phyo bya nag lding / /gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang / /ri dwags 'phyo dgu rgyal mtshan ba dan sgreng / /skyes pa pho dang za ma mo yi glud/ /pho gdong mo gdong shing gri yul mkhar ris/ /sman sna dar zab shing tog 'bru sna dang / /sha ris bza' bca' sna mang 'bru tshogs kyis/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun༞ /sogs/ kha dog lnga ldan rnga ma'i chun po dang / /snam ras dkar dmar sogs dang stag gzig ras/ /dzam ki mon pa bud med zlos gar bsgyur/ /khyad par rin chen las grub ga'u nang / /bla rdo gsang ba srog gi 'khor lo can/ /sna tshogs rin chen du mas legs gtam nas/ /dregs pa rang bzhin 'du ba'i rten rdzas sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos bshams yid sprul nam mkha'i khyon gang bar/ /gnod sbyin mched bdun༞ /rten mdos 'di la༞ /sngags 'chang bdag gi༞ /kyai ye zhes sbyar la/ btsan rgod tshig rkang drug la 'dod chags khros pa'i rang dbyangs rol mo bcas/ btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun 'khor bcas kyis/ /gnas skabs 'phel zhing de 'dzin tshogs rnams brtan/ /'jig rten spyi dang yang dgos bod yul 'dir/ /rgud pa kun zhi bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod/ /khyad par rigs 'dzin bdag cag dgon gnas sde/ /rgyu 'byor sbyin pa'i bdag po bcas pa la/ /de nas rnga phyir brdung dang / snga dgra lag bdar phyi dgra yid la sems/

/da dgra tsher ltar btsub pa'i bdud dpung gi /stobs 'byor mnga' thang tshe dang bsod nams snubs/ /bla tshe khug la srog rtsa dmar po chod/ /mdor na ming dang brda tsam ma lus par/ /thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin tu rlag par mdzod/ /rnga nang la/ bdag sogs dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ /tshe dpal bsod nams dbang thang stobs 'byor dang / /lung rtogs yon tan la sogs srid zhi yi/ /legs tshogs ma lus rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na sangs rgyas gnyis pa thod phreng rtsal/ /pad+ma dbang rgyal gnam lcags me 'bar rje/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la/ /bsam pa ji bzhin lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /rdzogs mtshams 'dir tshig rol/ lha khyod dgyes nas sngags 'chang gi tshig rol bar dang / steng na 'ja' ltar nas 'dur ma/ sngags 'chang gi tshig rol bar dang / btsan rgod nas 'dur ma/ 'phel bar mdzod kyi rjes su/ bdag sogs bsam don dpon slob sogs mthu la/ bsam pa ji bzhin la tshig rol gyi bar tshar gnyis te khyon gsum gyi ma'i/ bsam pa ji bzhin kyi tshig rol gyis mthar chems brdungs/ sgang dung / gsum brdeg len can/ nag po mchod rten gyis bshags pa sogs/ brgyun bskang ba'i 'phros rnams byas la/ bstod pa/ rngam 'bar/ rab 'bar/ ma skyes mkha' klong / hūm̐ yig rnams res mos/ tshogs gtor 'bul/ mjug chog phur chen bzhin la/ rjes 'brel bzhin bya/ nyin dang po/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs dang / bum nang gi ye shes pa zhes rjes chog la khyad par sbyor/ grol nyin byin dbab bsdus pa'i rgyas pa/ phur chen shur ma la/ bgegs byed pa yi bdud rnams sogs gdab kha rjes ma rnams bzhag par/ gtor bsngos nas tshogs kyi bshags pa'i bar gong bzhin lhag ma rgyas pa/ gtor 'bul phyir/ pu tra bskul sngon 'gro'i spyi stabs dang bstan skyong rgyas pa/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma sogs/

nang du log nas/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs phur chen gyi mjug chog dang / bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha sogs kyi bkra shis gang rgyas kyi gras la phur pa'i bkra shis rgyas pa'ang gdang ma bcas/ me tog gis char dang rol mo'i sgra rgya cher bya'o/ /zhes chos rgyal sku lnga dang / tse dmar ya ba skya bdun gyi mdos gzhung skyabs mgon rdo rje 'chang gong sa lnga pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang zhal snga nas kyi gsung tsam nyung ngur mdzad pa de dag las gyer gzhung nas bshoms thon pa bzhin sbyor ba nag 'gros su bkod/ dngos gzhir sku lnga'i gsol kha dang / phyogs phyogs ma chog khrigs can gyi lhu bsgrigs/ sku lnga'i bskyed chog sogs mi gsal ba rnams o rgyan smin grol gling gi gter bton chen po 'gyur med rdo rjes gsar rnying yi dam chos srung gi sgrub skor rjes gnang mang po phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang gi sku lnga'i srog gtad nas kha bskang / sngags drug phyag drug ni gsar rnying phal cher 'dra bas spyir btang dang / tse dmar gyi bskang ba mthu ldan kun khyab ma ni rgyas pa'i yan lag tu 'gyur ba las lhag chad gang gis skyon med pas de ltar shes par byas nas/ bdag mdun dbyangs rol sogs cho ga'i yan lag tu gyur pa rnams ni sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje yab sras kyi phyag len las ci rigs par sbyar te sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lag len bde bar bris pa'o/ /yang mdos gzhung rkyang pa ltar na/ rta mgrin gyi bdag mdun grub phral sku lnga dang tse dmar gyi mdos chog tshar re gtong tshul gong bzhin la sku lnga'i mjug gi chems brdung la kho rang gi gtor ma phud chang dang / tse dmar mjug gi chems brdung la'ang kho rang gi gtor phud bcas phyir 'bul/ tse dmar gyi mdos grub pa dang / srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma yongs grags bzhin dang /

'gro la phan bde ma lus bskyed pa'i rgyu/ /thub bstan skyon med yun ring gnas pa dang / /de 'dzin gang zag mchog rnams chos 'phel zhing / /chos kyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /skyabs mchog rin chen gsum gyi bden pa dang / /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa'i mthu stobs dang / /chos nyid rnam dag bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par shog /mjug chog gong gi gsol kha lugs la bkra shis rta mgrin mjug tu sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang sogs rgyun bskang bzhin/ dpal sa skya'i dus mchod bla brang gi tse dmar lcog gi mdos gang yod sku lnga'i yin 'dra yang / tse dmar gyi mdos sbyar du rung ste/ sku lnga'i gras su pu tra rdo rje dbang phyug dang tse dmar gcig cing / mchod gtor 'di rta mgrin la gong gi gsol kha lugs dang / snod gcig tu sku lnga la/ gcig tu tse dmar gyi gtor ma gong gi mdos gras la bshams pa bzhag phud chang bcas/ yi dam chos srung thun mong la sman raka chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer mchod rnams so/ /zhes dpal sa skya pa kun blos bris so// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ chos rgyal sku lnga dang tsi'u dmar ya ba skya bdun gyi rten mdos lag len gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
